none: PAS NLM-B0DB1A: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), a Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17, possibly Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths, a heart-shaped figure between them. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ NN]. Diameter: 10.9mm, Weight: 0.51gms, die axis: probably 6
